006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.markup.MarkupMultiline;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathException;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.node.IDefinitionNodeItem;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IAttributable;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IDescribable;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
018
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
021
022/**
023 * Represents a rule constraining the model of a Metaschema assembly, field or
024 * flag. Provides a common interface for all constraint definitions.
025 */
026public interface IConstraint extends IAttributable, IDescribable {
027  /**
028   * The type of constraint.
029   */
030  enum Type {
031    ALLOWED_VALUES("allowed-values"),
032    CARDINALITY("cardinality"),
033    EXPECT("expect"),
034    INDEX("index"),
035    UNIQUE("unique"),
036    INDEX_HAS_KEY("index-has-key"),
037    MATCHES("matches");
038
039    @NonNull
040    private final String name;
041
042    Type(@NonNull String name) {
043      this.name = name;
044    }
045
046    @NonNull
047    public String getName() {
048      return name;
049    }
050  }
051
052  /**
053   * The degree to which a constraint violation is significant.
054   * <p>
055   * These values are ordered from least significant to most significant.
056   */
057  enum Level {
058    /**
059     * No violation.
060     */
061    NONE,
062    /**
063     * A violation of the constraint represents a point of interest.
064     */
065    INFORMATIONAL,
066    /**
067     * A violation of the constraint represents a fault in the content that may
068     * warrant review by a developer when performing model or tool development.
069     */
070    DEBUG,
071    /**
072     * A violation of the constraint represents a potential issue with the content.
073     */
074    WARNING,
075    /**
076     * A violation of the constraint represents a fault in the content. This may
077     * include issues around compatibility, integrity, consistency, etc.
078     */
079    ERROR,
080    /**
081     * A violation of the constraint represents a serious fault in the content that
082     * will prevent typical use of the content.
083     */
084    CRITICAL;
085  }
086
087  /**
088   * Get the default level to use if no level is provided.
089   *
090   * @return the default level
091   */
092  @NonNull
093  static Level defaultLevel() {
094    return Level.ERROR;
095  }
096
097  /**
098   * Get the Metapath to use if no target is provided.
099   *
100   * @return the expression
101   */
102  @NonNull
103  static IMetapathExpression defaultTarget() {
104    return IMetapathExpression.contextNode();
105  }
106
107  /**
108   * Get a string that identifies the provided constraint using the most specific
109   * information available.
110   *
111   * @param constraint
112   *          the constraint to identify
113   * @return the constraint identification statement
114   */
115  @NonNull
116  static String getConstraintIdentity(@NonNull IConstraint constraint) {
117    String identity;
118    if (constraint.getId() != null) {
119      identity = String.format("with id '%s'", constraint.getId());
120    } else if (constraint.getFormalName() != null) {
121      identity = String.format("with the formal name '%s'", constraint.getFormalName());
122    } else {
123      identity = String.format("targeting '%s'", constraint.getTarget().getPath());
124    }
125    return ObjectUtils.notNull(identity);
126  }
127
128  /**
129   * Get the constraint type.
130   *
131   * @return the constraint type
132   */
133  @NonNull
134  Type getType();
135
136  /**
137   * Retrieve the unique identifier for the constraint.
138   *
139   * @return the identifier or {@code null} if no identifier is defined
140   */
141  @Nullable
142  String getId();
143
144  /**
145   * Get information about the source of the constraint.
146   *
147   * @return the source information
148   */
149  @NonNull
150  ISource getSource();
151
152  /**
153   * The significance of a violation of this constraint.
154   *
155   * @return the level
156   */
157  @NonNull
158  Level getLevel();
159
160  /**
161   * Retrieve the Metapath expression to use to query the targets of the
162   * constraint.
163   *
164   * @return a Metapath expression
165   */
166  @NonNull
167  IMetapathExpression getTarget();
168
169  /**
170   * Based on the provided {@code contextNodeItem}, find all nodes matching the
171   * target expression.
172   *
173   * @param item
174   *          the node item to evaluate the target expression against
175   * @param dynamicContext
176   *          the Metapath evaluation context to use
177   * @return the matching nodes as a sequence
178   * @throws MetapathException
179   *           if an error occurred during evaluation
180   * @see #getTarget()
181   */
182  @NonNull
183  ISequence<? extends IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?>> matchTargets(
184      @NonNull IDefinitionNodeItem<?, ?> item,
185      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext);
186
187  /**
188   * Retrieve the remarks associated with the constraint.
189   *
190   * @return the remarks or {@code null} if no remarks are defined
191   */
192  MarkupMultiline getRemarks();
193
194  /**
195   * Used for double dispatch supporting the visitor pattern provided by
196   * implementations of {@link IConstraintVisitor}.
197   *
198   * @param <T>
199   *          the Java type of a state object passed to the visitor
200   * @param <R>
201   *          the Java type of the result returned by the visitor methods
202   * @param visitor
203   *          the visitor implementation
204   * @param state
205   *          the state object passed to the visitor
206   * @return the visitation result
207   * @see IConstraintVisitor
208   */
209  <T, R> R accept(@NonNull IConstraintVisitor<T, R> visitor, T state);
210}
